verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only documents developer API endpoints for creating Person/Business/Account applications and KYC/KYB integration hooks — it never describes an ops-facing queue UI showing why an application is pending, a way to request/upload additional documents, or any distinction between platform-owned vs. bank-owned decisions. This is a plausible axis for a bank-partner onboarding platform, but nothing in the evidence shows such an ops console or decision-attribution feature.
